Real Estate Web App

Nilora Estates: Luxury Real Estate Platform, Cairo

A full MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) platform for Nilora Estates, a private residential agency selling villas, penthouses and coastal homes across Cairo and the Egyptian coast. It has a cinematic public site plus three role-based dashboards: buyers save homes and book private viewings, agents manage their listings and leads, and admins control properties, advisors, users and content.

Location
Cairo, Egypt
Year

Built with
MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js
  • Property listings for villas, penthouses and coastal homes with neighborhood guides
  • User dashboard to save homes, track enquiries and request private viewings
  • Agent dashboard to publish and edit listings and manage client leads
  • Admin dashboard to manage properties, advisors, users, journal posts and site content
  • Role-based authentication and secure REST API
  • SEO-ready pages with fast, responsive, cinematic design

Portfolio Website

Karim Ahmed: Full-Stack Developer Portfolio Website

A personal portfolio website for Karim Ahmed, a full-stack MERN developer and the founder of DevEraXTech, based in Cairo. Its cinematic, darkroom and film-roll design presents featured projects such as a university events and facilities management platform, along with skills, work experience, private one-on-one teaching sessions and a contact form. It is built to be secure, accessible and fast, with no third-party trackers.

Good to Know

Questions about our work

What kind of projects has DevEraXTech built?+

Our work includes Nilora Estates, a MERN stack real estate platform in Cairo with buyer, agent and admin dashboards, and karim.deveraxtech.com, a cinematic portfolio website for full-stack developer Karim Ahmed, alongside business websites, online stores and landing pages.

Which technologies does DevEraXTech use?+

We mainly build with React and Node.js, using MongoDB and Express.js for full-stack MERN web applications, React Native for mobile apps, and Shopify or WordPress when a store or content-heavy site is the better fit.

Can I see more examples relevant to my industry?+

Yes. Tell us about your project through the contact page and we will share the examples and approaches that are most relevant to your industry.

Can you build a project like these for my business?+

Yes. Each project on this page started with a short discovery call. Book a meeting and we will map out the pages, features, timeline and budget for your version.
